data.profile: VinGroup Joint Stock Company (VIC), formerly known as Vietnam General Trading Joint Stock Company, was established in 2002. The Group has its main business in real estate, tourist resorts - entertainment, retail, manufacturing industry and social infrastructure. VIC currently develops and operates urban township projects across numerous provinces and cities in Vietnam, with approximately 28 projects already in operation. In the retail real estate segment, the Group develops and operates a nationwide network of 90 shopping malls, including 61 Vincom Plaza malls across 32 provinces and cities and 15 Vincom+ centers in 10 provinces and cities, following an integrated model that combines shopping, entertainment, and dining. In the automotive manufacturing sector, VinFast is currently present in North America (the United States and Canada), Europe (Germany, the Netherlands, and France), the Middle East (the United Arab Emirates and Oman), and Asia (Vietnam, Indonesia, the Philippines, and India). In 2025, VinFast maintained its position as the leading automobile brand in Vietnam, delivering more than 175,000 vehicles, while ranking second in the motorcycle market with over 406,000 units delivered. As of the end of 2025, VinFast operated 424 showrooms and more than one million charging ports worldwide. In addition, VIC also invested and developed social infrastructure in healthcare and education. VIC has been listed and traded on Hochiminh Stock Exchange (HOSE) since September 2007.
